commits.message:
fix(highlighter)!: ISO8601Highlighter lays Rich's spans in Rich's colours (rich-highlighter-6cj4)

ISO8601Highlighter now carries Rich 15.0.0's patterns: each matches a whole
string that is one ISO 8601 value and lays year/month/day/week/hour/minute/
second/frac/ms/hyphen spans under date/time/timezone. iso8601.date is blue,
iso8601.time magenta, iso8601.timezone yellow, as in rich.default_styles.

BREAKING CHANGE: a date or time inside other text ("date: 2023-01-15") is no
longer highlighted; Rich's patterns are anchored to the whole string.

test/core/iso8601-highlight.golden.json is Rich's own output for its
iso8601_highlight_tests corpus plus three edge cases.

effects-feel: breaths, flashes and passes of light are events of their own (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i) (#318)

* effects-feel: breaths, flashes and passes of light are events of their own; the step gate watches half an hour (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

Pulse: most breaths shallow and quick, about one in six a deep sigh, each
starting early or late in its turn. Sparkle: a firefly flashes, hovers,
fades, and flashes again a few cells off. Shimmer: a glitter path, each
pass at its own pace after a still spell of its own. A weaker event is a
shorter one (swell), so variety costs no smoothness.

The 1 fps step gate sampled 300 s; over 600 s drift and sparkle already
broke it. It now checks every second of 1800 s.

* effects-feel: a firefly's period is its turn, and every loop clears the step bar with room (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

Review high on #318:
- sparkle: `seconds` is the firefly's turn (default 140; the brightest
  flash still ~84 s), dark turns 15%, one firefly per eight columns. A
  text-sized element is dark 2-5% of the time, not 30%, and never for minutes.
- swell of strength 0 is 0 everywhere, so sparkle's k===0 special case goes.
- pulse 33 s, drift's gusts softer-edged and slower to churn: over an hour,
  four elements, two frame offsets and two widths, no loop steps past 0.037.
- the step gate watches two elements, the second between the first's frames.
- tests: pulse's inhale is found, not assumed at t=3.4; sparkle counts cells
  lit to the eye, not cells a byte changed.

* effects-feel: the flash's share of a turn is said where it is set (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)
